title: The Garden Delivery
objective: Find the seed packet in the shed and carry it into the garden. The brass key in the cottage opens the garden gate.

entities.name: Cottage
entities.description: Morning light fills a small cottage. A brass key rests on the kitchen table. The shed is east.

entities.name: Shed
entities.description: A tidy shed smells of fresh wood. A seed box sits on the floor. The cottage is west and the garden is north beyond a locked gate.

entities.name: Garden
entities.description: Sunlight warms the empty flower beds. This is the perfect place for the seeds. The shed is south.

entities.name: kitchen table
entities.description: A sturdy wooden table with a brass key on top.

entities.name: brass key
entities.description: A small brass key for the garden gate.

entities.name: seed box
entities.description: A small wooden box. Open it to find the seeds.

entities.name: seed packet
entities.description: A paper packet of sunflower seeds, ready for the garden.

solution: take brass key from kitchen table
take seed packet from seed box
unlock garden gate with brass key
